conclusion: No remaining P0/P1/P2 finding in the bounded candidate. The focus change preserves escaped review text, captured submission values, expiry and acknowledgement guards. Final runner corrections account for CSS text casing and re-enter the synthetic form recipient after the existing rates refresh without bypassing review checks.
limits: This is a bounded diff and browser-evidence review, not a whole-application security audit or closure of the E4 gate.
Chrome viewport and keyboard automation do not establish human comprehension, real Telegram integration, screen-reader behavior, touch behavior or iOS/WebKit compatibility.
The browser uses synthetic API responses and blocked external assets/SDKs; it does not establish live order execution, settlement, wallet signing or production API correctness.
The historical baseline report corroborates the original scrolled-checkbox opening but lacks a runner hash; it is not claimed as a rerun of the exact final browser suite.
The reviewer did not independently rerun the live browser. Final code, supplied run evidence, selected screenshots and current exact-unit cleanup were independently checked.
No production rollout, frozen 064A operation, credential/customer-data access or supervisor modification was performed by this reviewer. Only this requested review artifact was written.
